payload.title: Correlation Analysis in Pyleoclim
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library for correlation analysis in paleoclimatology. It focuses on comparing age-uncertain records and computing correlations between records and gridded fields. The notebook utilizes various statistical methods, including Pearson's R, Spearman's ρ, and Kendall's τ, to assess correlations and significance. It also addresses the multiple comparisons problem and demonstrates the use of surrogate data for significance testing.
